title: 财跃星辰小财神 MCP 配置
description: 请输入您的专属 Access Token。如尚未申请，点击下方链接查看使用指南，按指引在财跃星辰官网提交试用申请，我们将在 1-2 个工作日内通过邮件发送。凭证仅保存在您本机 ~/.workbuddy 目录下，不会上传云端。
description_en: Enter your Access Token. If you don't have one, click the link below for the setup guide and apply on the Finstep website. Credentials are stored locally in ~/.workbuddy and never uploaded.
docLabel_en: How to apply for an Access Token?

fields.label: Access Token
fields.placeholder: 粘贴邮件中收到的 Key，形如 AI-ONE-xxxx
fields.placeholder_en: Paste the token from your email
fields.description: 在财跃星辰官网提交试用申请，审核通过后由邮件发送
fields.description_en: Sent by email after your trial application is approved.
